headline: Anthropic is reported to be considering Samsung's 2-nanometre technology to build its own custom AI chip, according to unconfirmed leaks.
score_reason: Kept at the pool level: unconfirmed specifications from social media leakers, relayed by one fan-news site.
importance_line: If true, it would show AI labs building their own chips and Samsung winning advanced chip work, but none of the companies has confirmed anything and the specifications are leaks.
source: Sammy Fans, citing SemiconductorsX and Jukan
summary: Sammy Fans reports, citing the social media accounts SemiconductorsX and Jukan, that Anthropic is reportedly weighing Samsung's 2-nanometre process for a custom AI chip designed with Broadcom, said to reach about 4,000 TOPS (a measure of AI processing speed), with 192 gigabytes of fast memory and an initial run of about 200,000 chips. Neither Anthropic, Samsung nor Broadcom is quoted, and the specifications are described only as reported.
notes: Read; leak-based, single outlet, no company confirmation. Page text truncated after the production figure.
